Shatabdi 12002: New Delhi 6:00 AM → Agra Cantt 7:50 AM (1 hr 50), runs daily, chair car and executive
Vande Bharat 22470: Hazrat Nizamuddin 6:00 AM → Agra Cantt 7:40 AM (1 hr 40), chair car and executive
Gatimaan 12050: Hazrat Nizamuddin 8:10 AM → Agra Cantt 9:50 AM (1 hr 40), chair car and executive
Taj Express 12280: New Delhi 6:55 AM → Agra Cantt 9:25 AM (2 hr 30), runs daily, cheaper chair car and 2S

For sleeper or AC berths, Punjab Mail 12138 leaves New Delhi at 5:10 AM and reaches Agra Cantt at 8:10 AM (3 hr). It runs daily.

The page was cut off after the 11:15 AM trains, so later ones are missing. It also doesn't show seats or fares, and I couldn't use IRCTC because it blocked me. Check the running days for Vande Bharat and Gatimaan before you plan around them.
